purpose: Retain every 2025-dated article in the already frozen NIST CHIPS archive as a separately bounded later-source set for review against the frozen 45-group 2024 PMT manufacturing population. Do not select only final-award titles or replace the original cohort.
policy_basis: Main reviewer re-read the complete retained NIST robots and Copyrights & Disclaimers policies in this turn. The exact canonical /news-events/news/2025/ article URLs do not match robot exclusions. NIST information is public and may be copied except marked copyrighted material and product-specific restrictions; preserve attribution and separately adjudicate any marked exceptions. The capture must recheck both current normalized policies and stop source requests on policy drift. Retrieve only original HTML, no linked images, attachments, issuer sites, credentials, cookies, redirects or retries.
scope: All 11 calendar-2025 rows at displayed positions 1-11, in index order, including personnel, research, new-PMT and award articles. Exact index titles are identity checks, not outcome evidence. Current archive selection may omit differently tagged or removed reports and is not a comprehensive current-events search. New 2025 projects do not enter the 2024 PMT cohort. Local review only, no core ingestion, model training, public raw redistribution, forecast scoring or scheduled-runtime changes.
prior_exposure: Reviewers are already exposed to known outcomes, earlier final-award articles and later guidance. New captures use actual September 2026 clocks and do not prove exact historical content availability. Funding finalization/withdrawal, construction and manufacturing attainment require separate semantics and project correspondence.
